text:
jess: Heads up — I’m seeing a steady rise in ECC Corrected counts on a handful of us-west2 GPUs over the last 24h. Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abcd/gpu-ecc?orgId=1 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sam: which nodes?

jess: gpu-usw2-rl-03, gpu-usw2-rl-07, gpu-usw2-rl-09. counts jumped from ~10/day to ~200/day on rl-09.

ariane: yikes. Any Xid 31 or Xid 43 errors in the kube logs?

jess: there were transient Xid 31s on rl-09 earlier today, but pods recovered. snippet from daemonset logs:
```
2026-02-25T02:14:12Z kubelet gpu-usw2-rl-09 kubelet: Container runtime error: NVIDIA Xid 31, GPU 0
2026-02-25T02:14:13Z node-exporter gpu-usw2-rl-09 metrics: ecc_corrected_count{gpu="0"} 157
```

luca: ECC corrected growth + Xid 31 together usually mean memory-bit instability. Could be early row remap activity.

michael: do we have page retirement metrics from nvidia-smi?

jess: grabbed `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY` from rl-09: 
```
Attached GPUs: 1
GPU 0000:65:00.0
    FB Memory Usage
       Total                       : 488281 MB
       Used                        : 1024 MB
    ECC Errors
       Volatile
          ECC Errors (Corrected): 298
       Aggregate
          L1 Cache ECC Errors (Corrected) : 0
          DRAM ECC Errors (Corrected)     : 298
    Retired Pages
       Volatile: 3
       Permanently Retired: 0
```

ariane: 3 retired pages on one GPU is borderline but the rapid increase is the concern. If it ramps we hit permanent retire and perf drop.

sam: What's the policy threshold again for auto-drain? ops-bot normally kicks when corrected >500 or retired_pages >10 in 24h?

ops-bot: auto-drain check: node gpu-usw2-rl-09 corrected=298 retired=3 threshold_corrected=500 threshold_retired=10 -> NO ACTION

luca: we should still triage before it crosses thresholds. Plan: 1) put rl-09 into maintenance mode (cordon+drain non-critical pods) 2) run memtest on GPU via remote job, 3) schedule replacement if memtest flaps or retired pages increment

michael: agree. Also run `nvidia-persistenced` restart and collect ECC debug logs. Add tags to the node: `gpu_health=watch` so auto-schedulers avoid it.

jess: starting cordon/drain for low-priority pods now. I’ll leave critical inference lanes until we confirm fallback capacity.

sam: Where do we track the triage? Put in #incidents or infra runbook?

luca: create short thread in incidents with node IDs + grafana link. Also add an entry in the gpu-fleet spreadsheet (sheet: hardware-failures).

jess: memtest job queued: `kubectl run gpu-memtest --image=redwood/memtest:latest --restart=OnFailure --limits=nvidia.com/gpu=1 --overrides='{"spec": {"nodeName": "gpu-usw2-rl-09"}}'`

ariane: can you also grab `dmesg` around the Xid times and check for PCIe link errors? sometimes bad cabling shows similar patterns.

jess: will do. quick dmesg grep:
```
[Feb25 02:13:11] NVRM: RmInitAdapter(0000:65:00.0): Xid (31): Ch 00000000, GPU has fallen off the bus
[Feb25 02:13:12] pcieport 0000:64:00.0: AER: Corrected error, received: id=00e0
```

michael: that AER corrected line suggests upstream PCIe transient, could be switch port. Let's not replace HW yet.

luca: agreed. Steps: (A) isolate node (cordon+tag), (B) run memtest and stress, (C) restart nvidia driver + persistenced, (D) monitor retired pages for 6 hours. If retired_pages increments or memtest fails -> schedule replacement. If PCIe AER continues -> open ticket with cloud provider hardware ops.

sam: can we temporarily shift traffic? We have spare capacity in us-west1 dedicated pool. Ops: please run routing policy to direct new inference sessions to us-west1 for 2 hours while we test.

ops-bot: Routing change applied: new sessions -> us-west1-dedicated for tag=low-latency, ttl=2h.

ariane: also add alert rule: if corrected_delta > 200 in 1h or retired_pages > 5 -> create pager. I'll add to grafana.

jess: memtest started, currently at ~35% pass, no errors so far. I'll paste results when done.

michael: thanks. if memtest is clean but ECC counters keep climbing, we escalate to replacement. keep an eye on rl-07 and rl-03 too — can hit multiple nodes same hardware batch.

jess: noted, putting rl-07 and rl-03 into watch (tagged). I’ll update the spreadsheet and post an incidents thread once we have memtest result. :thumbsup:
